claim: Complete list of all 12 three-star Michelin restaurants in Tokyo for the 2026 guide, including Myojaku as the sole newcomer
quote: There are 12 restaurants with three stars. Tokyo's current crop of three-Michelin-starred establishments includes six Japanese restaurants, five specializing in French cuisine and one that does Chinese cuisine.

claim: Tokyo retains its title as the world's most Michelin-starred city with 160 starred restaurants in 2026
quote: Tokyo retains Michelin crown with 160 starred restaurants for 2026

claim: Myojaku chef Hidetoshi Nakamura uses submarine groundwater as the primary seasoning medium, connecting mountain and sea
quote: Chef Hidetoshi Nakamura's cuisine embodies harmony, subtlety and purity, connecting land and sea — using minimal seasoning and pristine submarine groundwater

quote: Chef's Table (private room): ¥63,250 lunch / ¥101,200 dinner (tax included). Children must be 13+. The restaurant cannot accommodate vegan, vegetarian, or specific allergen-related needs.

claim: SÉZANNE at Four Seasons Hotel Tokyo at Marunouchi was awarded its third Michelin star in October 2024
quote: SÉZANNE at Four Seasons Hotel Tokyo at Marunouchi Ascends to Pinnacle of Culinary Excellence with Three Michelin Stars

claim: Gastronomy Joël Robuchon at Yebisu Garden Place is led by Chef Kenichiro Sekiya, a Meilleurs Ouvriers de France recipient
quote: Kenichiro Sekiya, recipient of the prestigious Meilleurs Ouvriers de France (MOF) and heir to both the spirit and cuisine of his famous mentor, uses Japanese ingredients to breathe new life into French gastronomy.

claim: Kanda is now located at Toranomon Hills Residential Tower and seats 9 at the counter; Chef Hiroyuki Kanda plans each day's menu based on the morning's freshest ingredients

claim: Nihonryori RyuGin relocated to the 7th floor of Tokyo Midtown Hibiya in 2018

claim: L'OSIER received three Michelin stars for the eighth consecutive year in the 2026 guide
quote: L'OSIER Receives Three Stars for Eighth Straight Year

claim: L'Effervescence is run by Chef Shinobu Namae and offers vegetarian-friendly options; reservations require two months advance booking with a credit card
quote: L'Effervescence — innovative French cuisine. Book two months ahead.

claim: Sazenka reservations open on the 1st of each month for dates two months ahead; open Tuesday through Saturday from 4 PM

quote: The head chef trained for over 10 years under Jiro Ono at Sukiyabashi Jiro. The omakase menu features approximately 15 types of nigiri and 10 appetizers.

claim: Myojaku reservations are available from ¥44,000 via Pocket Concierge
quote: Myoujyaku reservations starting from ¥44,000

claim: Sazenka is bookable through TABLEALL as one of its featured fine dining reservations
quote: Sazenka — Restaurant Reservation Service in Japan — TABLEALL

claim: Azabu Kadowaki accepts reservations via TableCheck; single-person bookings are not accepted at the counter
quote: The restaurant does not accept reservations for one person at the counter.

claim: Most Tokyo Michelin restaurants open their reservation books one month ahead, and 18:00–19:00 Saturday dinner slots disappear within hours
quote: Most Michelin restaurants in Tokyo open their books one month ahead, sometimes two during busy seasons, and the 6pm-7pm dinner slots disappear first.

claim: Pocket Concierge gives access to Tokyo premier restaurants with no service fee; reservations are fully handled online in English
quote: Pocket Concierge doesn't even charge a service fee! Sign up through e-mail, Facebook or Line, check availability, and reserve — you don't even need to make a phone call.

claim: Staying at a luxury hotel (Aman, Mandarin Oriental, Peninsula, Four Seasons) provides concierge access to high-end restaurant reservations that are otherwise unavailable
quote: If you're staying at a five-star hotel (Aman, Mandarin Oriental, Peninsula, etc.), the concierge typically has reservation arrangements with high-end local restaurants.

claim: Ryugin enforces a strict dress code: no shorts, sandals or sleeveless tops for men; perfume is absolutely prohibited as it compromises dish aromas
